newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Karachi bourse to close on Sundays, not Fridays.
newsitem.headline: Karachi bourse to close on Sundays, not Fridays.

text.p: Pakistan's premier bourse, the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE), said on Tuesday it would observe Sunday as the weekly holiday instead of Friday.
"The general body of the members...has decided to observe Sunday as the weekly holiday, instead of Friday, effective from October 4, 1996," a statement issued by the KSE said.
Trading at the exchange will now commence from Monday to Friday while Saturday and Sunday will be observed as the weekly holidays.
The statement said the decision had been taken on the appeal of the Federation of Pakistan Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FPCCI) to switch the weekly holiday to Sunday from Friday.
Businessmen say the holiday on Friday effectively cut them off from markets in Europe and the U.S. where Saturday and Sunday are observed as regular days off.
KSE said trading hours on Friday would be from 0500 to 0715 GMT about two hours less than the normal trading hours to let members and staff go for congregational prayers.
